rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese word for a garage used to keep a car and other items.

example.english: I parked the car in the garage, and there are tools stored inside too.
example.traditional: 我將架車停咗喺車房，入面仲擺住啲工具。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 gaa3 ce1 ting4 zo2 hai2 ce1 fong4 jap6 min6 zung6 baai2 zyu6 di1 gung1 geoi6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a purpose-built car-storage or parking building rather than a general 車房.

example.english: This purpose-built garage is just for residents to park in.
example.traditional: 呢座車庫係專畀住戶泊車用嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 ce1 fu3 hai6 zyun1 bei2 zyu6 wu6 bok6 ce1 jung6 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a petrol filling station, not a building for storing a private car.

example.english: I went to the garage to fill up the tank before going home.
example.traditional: 我去油站入滿缸油先返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 jau4 zaam6 jap6 mun5 gong1 jau4 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2
